commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /tmp/normalize_text_exports.py <<'PY_EOF'
from pathlib import Path
import os
root = Path('/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization')
incoming = root / 'incoming'
outdir = root / 'normalized'
report = root / 'normalization-errors.tsv'
outdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rows = []
for number, raw in enumerate((root / 'encodings.tsv').read_text(encoding='ascii').splitlines(), 1):
    if not raw.strip():
        continue
    parts = raw.split()
    if number == 1 and parts == ['file', 'encoding']:
        continue
    if len(parts) != 2:
        raise SystemExit(f'encodings.tsv:{number}: expected filename and encoding')
    rows.append(tuple(parts))
errors = []
for name, encoding in rows:
    src = incoming / name
    dest = outdir / name
    tmp = outdir / ('.' + name + '.tmp')
    try:
        data = src.read_bytes()
        text_value = data.decode(encoding, errors='strict')
        normalized = text_value.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').encode('utf-8', errors='strict')
        with tmp.open('wb') as handle:
            handle.write(normalized)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp, dest)
        print(f'PUBLISHED\t{name}\t{encoding}\t{len(data)}->{len(normalized)} bytes')
    except UnicodeError as exc:
        try:
            tmp.unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        try:
            dest.unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        reason = str(exc).replace('\t', ' ').replace('\n', ' ')
        errors.append((name, encoding, reason))
        print(f'UNDECODABLE\t{name}\t{encoding}\t{reason}')
report_tmp = report.with_name('.' + report.name + '.tmp')
with report_tmp.open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as handle:
    handle.write('file\tencoding\terror\n')
    for name, encoding, reason in errors:
        handle.write(f'{name}\t{encoding}\t{reason}\n')
    handle.flush()
    os.fsync(handle.fileno())
os.replace(report_tmp, report)
print(f'ERROR_REPORT\t{report}\t{len(errors)} error(s)')
PY_EOF
python3 /tmp/normalize_text_exports.py
